The '''Trader's Guild''' was a guild that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[O'in Tielord|O'in Tiellord]] was the Trader's Guild's [[Captain/Legends|captain]].
